declared_before: Any T106 learned-policy collection, fitting or scored transfer evaluation

dependency.failed_prerequisite_action: Publish immutable training_blocked before importing Torch, opening a host, loading a checkpoint or invoking a trainer

capability_matching.unavailable_outputs: Zero their wire contribution and retain an explicit capability-mask label; never invent an actuator
capability_matching.aim: Unit direction from the observed root part to the explicit caller target; zero when coincident
capability_matching.normalization: Normalize the requested move vector to unit length; signed drive/trim in [-1,1], effort in [0,1]
capability_matching.claim_limit: Capabilities match within each profile; shared button or semantic names do not imply identical abilities between profiles

observations.padding: Unavailable or detached node/edge values and validity are zero; padding does not update recurrence or contribute loss
observations.locality: Each graph node has own pose/motion/geometry and the explicit goal; current joint sensors cross only their incident connection
shared_command: explicit target used with each part's own position
excluded: passive wrench invented from aggregate motion
observations.geometry: Authored rectangle sizes, masses, offsets and joint parameters are supplied numerically; IDs remain evidence metadata

shared_graph.information_reach: At most two graph hops of current input per decision; older memory can propagate through later decisions

candidates.compute_interpretation: Same ceilings and game-collection allocation; report actual cost. Dense MAC counts and memory use differ, so this is an architecture-package comparison, not a claim of identical FLOPs or a pure topology ablation

splits.whole_profile_holdout: All connections, actuator arrangements, authored sizes, masses and offsets of both zero-shot profiles remain absent from optimization
splits.placement: Use each accepted profile's authored floor spawn, x=264 for left or x=176 for right, subtract the named drop height; target root floor position plus the named horizontal displacement
splits.geometry_factorization: Whole heldout profiles change both arrangement and numeric geometry; independent arbitrary geometry sweeps remain unavailable through the accepted host API
splits.identity_memorization_control: No learned identity embedding; numerical node-slot permutation equivariance test for the shared graph, with the padded policy's ordering dependence explicitly retained
splits.zero_shot_opening: Only after all six shared final checkpoint hashes freeze
splits.adaptation: Fresh fork of the same shared checkpoint for each heldout profile; no cross-profile adaptation state; freeze all adapted hashes before the separate adaptation evaluation

future_learning.method: Matched full-episode BC initialization then bounded recurrent PPO with ordered unrolls, duration-based discount and intervention exclusion; implementation/admission is deferred by the failed prerequisite
future_learning.reference_control: A bounded waypoint reference must be qualified under this exact semantic action map before teacher collection; the existing T103 hop controller is not silently relabelled as this new task
future_learning.checkpoint_selection: Fixed final update for every seed, never best seed or holdout-selected epoch
future_learning.existing_t105_weights: Evidence only; no checkpoint reuse or initialization by a selected lucky seed

future_metrics.success: Within four cells, speed <=6 cells/s and root absolute angle <=0.35 radians for twelve consecutive ticks before the observable 240-tick task deadline
report: adaptation game decisions and wall cost
response onset and peak useful speed
future_metrics.comparison_gate: Graph must gain >=0.125 mean paired zero-shot success over the padded family, with a strictly positive 95% bootstrap lower bound across the three trained policy seeds, while every seed passes runtime/integrity and per-profile character bounds fixed before any future run
future_metrics.uncompleted_or_missing_rows: Inconclusive and gate closed; never silently discarded or counted as convenient successes
future_metrics.no_go: Keep the simpler policy when the graph does not show a reliable benefit within the same declared allocation
unavailable: independent arbitrary geometry or assist sweeps
Windows physical runtime and GPU qualification

conformance_only.ending: owner cancellation in a valid continuing state after four six-tick requests
